Name: Herod Agrippa II
Summary: Herod Agrippa II was the last Herodian king, ruling parts of the north-east. Festus brought Paul before him at Caesarea, and Agrippa heard Paul's defence, remarking that Paul almost persuaded him to be a Christian.
KeyStory: Agrippa listened to Paul's whole story and sent him to Rome, judging he had done nothing worthy of death.
LifeLesson: Almost persuaded is still unpersuaded. Agrippa heard the gospel clearly and walked away a king instead of a Christian.
